rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance relocation payments for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions (owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvements, substantial rehabilitation), the landlord must pay relocation to each tenant, up to a per-unit maximum, plus an extra amount for each elderly, disabled or minor-child household. Ellis Act evictions have a separate, higher schedule. Amounts depend on the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.key_value: Notices served 3/1/2026-2/28/2027: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child; Ellis Act: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13, plus $7,443.90
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the rate period currently in effect (as of 2026-10-01); rates adjust each March 1. Original schedule dates from 2006.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not § 37.9C.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units covered by the SF Rent Ordinance; amount fixed by the date the eviction notice is served.

unverifiable_exemptions: Exemptions under the Rent Ordinance (e.g., government-owned or certain subsidized housing) cannot be verified from parcel data

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board archive of relocation payment rates under Rent Ordinance § 37.9C for no-fault evictions and Ellis Act evictions, with the current schedule (3/1/2026-2/28/2027) and historical rates back to 2006.
